description.value:
As an Action, you open a small portal and call upon the raw energy of your patron's powerful breath weapon.

Every creature in the area of effect, which originates from your position, has to make a Saving Throw against your spell save DC. A target takes 15d10 damage on a failed save, and half as much on a successful one. The shape, Saving Throw, and damage type of the breath weapon depends on your draconic patron.

You cannot use this feature again until you have finished a Long Rest.
